title: H-VAEP and H-xT: Valuing Offensive On-the-Ball Actions in Handball by Estimating Probabilities
abstract: arXiv:2608.12926v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Traditional player evaluation in professional handball relies on basic box-score metrics or heuristic indices, which fail to credit the multi-player build-up chain. While football (soccer) analytics has adopted Expected Threat (xT) and Valuing Actions by Estimating Probabilities (VAEP), these event-based action valuation frameworks have not yet been adapted to handball. In this paper, we present the first comprehensive adaptation and evaluation of xT and VAEP for handball, utilizing five seasons of tracking-derived event data from the Handball Bundesliga. We develop Handball-xT (H-xT) using a handball-native court zoning layout, demonstrating via simulations that it is systematically more robust than standard rectangular grids. We optimize Handball-VAEP (H-VAEP) by tailoring its feature space and selecting the context length to limit team-identity leakage. translated_title: H-VAEP与H-xT：通过概率估计评估手球中进攻性持球动作的价值
translated_abstract: 传统职业手球中的球员评估依赖于基本的技术统计指标或启发式指数，这些方法未能充分体现多人配合的进攻链条。尽管足球（英式足球）分析已采用预期威胁（xT）和通过概率估计评估动作价值（VAEP），但这些基于事件的动作价值框架尚未被适配到手球中。在本文中，我们首次对手球中的xT和VAEP进行了全面的适配与评估，利用了来自德国手球甲级联赛五个赛季的追踪衍生事件数据。我们开发了手球版xT（H-xT），采用手球原生球场分区布局，并通过模拟证明其系统性地比标准矩形网格更稳健。我们优化了手球版VAEP（H-VAEP），通过定制其特征空间并选择上下文长度以限制球队身份泄露。我们的评估显示，H-VAEP产生了极其稳定、具有判别性的结果，并且...
tldr: 本文首次将足球分析中的xT和VAEP方法适配到手球领域，开发了H-xT和H-VAEP模型，通过手球原生球场布局和优化特征空间，实现了更稳健和稳定的进攻动作价值评估。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first adaptation of football's xT and VAEP frameworks to handball, developing H-xT and H-VAEP models with handball-native court zoning and optimized features for robust and stable offensive action valuation.
